items.text: Client reported continuing difficulty accepting help without obligation,I still do not know how to let people take care of me without feeling like I owe them something

Client is rehearsing brief requests about task order before pressure builds,I need to ask for priorities before I'm already overwhelmed and noted a moment of physiological activation when doing so,My heart was racing before I spoke

A cross‑session pattern to review is escalating pressure followed by work‑focused guilt,lately it feels like I am either working, thinking about working, or feeling guilty that I am not working and I did not ask which case had priority

Would you like to explore whether receiving care reliably triggers a felt obligation,Someone helps me and then I feel like I have to repay them right away and I still do not know how to let people take care of me without feeling like I owe them something
Client linked some of the pattern to increased family responsibility when their father became ill,My family relied on me a lot when my dad got sick last year
